name: omnilab/interpro
description: Omnilab InterPro: an InterPro entry (IPR000971) or a Pfam family (PF00042) - its name, type, description, member signatures, GO terms, protein and structure counts, Pfam clan, representative structure, overlapping entries and hierarchy - a UniProt protein with the InterPro entries and Pfam families it matches, by type and position, as related things, and a search of InterPro entries, through the InterPro API, no key needed.
